borrow_or_financing: none (long-only spot index ETFs and SHY, no leverage, no shorting)
cost_model: sum(abs(delta_weight)) * slippage_bps, charged on the execution session (next session open after the close signal)
k2_control_cost_model: the vol-matched k*S3+(1-k)*SHY control pays no rebalancing cost (conservative in the control's favor, matching every prior batch-screening round's convention)
note_vs_source_holding_period: Quantpedia's own construction is Friday close to Friday close; this project's frozen contract is close-signal -> next-session-open fill, so the effective entry is one session later (the next trading day's open after the pre-week signal day) and WEEK's exit is one session later than the expiration week's own close. This is a fixed contract constraint applied identically to every screen_lane batch, not a change made for this candidate.
